newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian concerned over tension in Bulgaria.
newsitem.headline: Russian concerned over tension in Bulgaria.

text.p: Russia voiced its concern on Saturday over growing tensions in neighbouring Bulgaria, which it described as a friendly state once seen as an "island of stability" in the troubled Balkans.
A statement issued by the Foreign Ministry said Moscow hoped the crisis in Bulgaria would be resolved "through dialogue within the constitution and democratic traditions".
Bulgarian opposition protestors who want to break the ex-communist ruling party's grip on power formed a human chain around the parliament building on Friday.
The action turned into a 10-hour siege during during which demonstrators broke windows in the parliament and smashed and overturned cars outside.

"Such developments are worrying especially because we are talking about a friendly state that has enjoyed in recent years a well-deserved reputation as an "island of stability' in the troubled Balkan region," the statement said.
